turns.speaker: user
turns.text: We just got to the campground and our site is huge. Where should the tent actually go?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Look for the flattest patch you can find, a little higher than the ground around it. If it rains, low spots turn into puddles.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: There's a nice flat bit right under a big old tree.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Check the branches above it first. Dead limbs can drop in wind, so if anything looks cracked or bare, move away.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hmm, one branch does look kind of

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: dead, now that I'm staring at it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Then skip that spot. Shade is lovely, but not worth a branch through the roof.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay. What about near the fire pit?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Close enough to enjoy it, but at least a few big steps away, and not downwind. Sparks and nylon don't get along.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Got it. Upwind, flat, no killer branches.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's it. Door facing away from the wind too, if you can.
